Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of SCHW.
Operating income reached $10.0 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 21% to 12% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
We generated $7.6 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 64 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 64 basis points to 49.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
